body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-11-07 (Q2FY26 concall transcript): "for the full year, certainly, I think we can look at a number closer to INR600 crores odd in this division. And then I would say that INR1,000 crores number should be possible, maybe if not next year, certainly in the year after that ... [double digit margin] It's long term." Metric: Polymer segment revenue / margin. Target: ~INR 600 cr FY26; INR 1,000 cr by FY28. Deadline: 2026-03-31 (600 cr); 2028-03-31 (1,000 cr). Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: partly. Evidence: FY26 polymer INR 507 cr = 85% of ~600 cr. The INR 1,000 cr leg (FY27/FY28) is pending and lost its date in Apr-26. Explanation given: falling resin prices cut value growth (Apr-26, prompted)
